title: Fields & arrays
subtitle: Controllers and nested paths
description: Work with single fields, nested paths, and array helpers.
content: Paths use dot notation (`profile.contact.email`). Arrays use index segments (`tags.0`).

sections.title: field(path)
sections.content: Returns a controller with `value`, `set`, `reset`, `touch`, `validate`, and meta (`isChanged`, `error`, …).

sections.title: array(path)
sections.content: `append`, `prepend`, `insert`, `remove`, `swap`, `move`, plus `fields` with stable `id`s for list keys.

sections.title: Readonly / strict mode
sections.content: `fields` config + `fieldMode: "strict"` can restrict which paths are editable.
